backupRetention: we do not keep automatic database backups; encrypted manual backups taken before major maintenance are kept for up to 30 days and then deleted
logRetention: server and hosting logs are kept for up to 7 days
processingLocations: the database and uploaded media are stored by Supabase in Singapore; backend functions run on Supabase's global edge network; the website is served by Vercel's global network; support email is forwarded by Cloudflare to Google Gmail; and content you choose to publish is sent to Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
